item.title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves wins Best Fighting Game at The Game Awards 2025
item.description: <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2025/dec/11/game-awards-2025-announcements/">The Game Awards 2025</a> went down last night with plenty of announcements and awards to go around.</p> <p>Although neither Kakeru nor Weibo|MenaRD unfortunately ended up winning the Best Esports Athlete at The Game Awards, there was still another category specifically for fighting games.</p>

item.title: Arcade1Up reportedly shutting down today
item.description: <p>Although the arcade era of the '90s is long gone at this point, Arcade1Up had stepped into the space to bring the experience home, but now that may be going away as well.</p> <p>Reports are circulating that Arcade1Up will be effectively closing up shop.</p>

item.title: One of the most absurd fighting games ever made is going to be at Evo Japan 2026 and I can't wait to see it on the big stage

item.title: Tournament organizers banned for collusion from Tekken World Tour by Bandai Namco
item.description: <p>The FGC is supposed to be all about community and comradery around fighting games as the name suggests, but bad actors can pop up any time to try and ruin everyone's fun.</p> <p>Bandai Namco announced they are banning some tournament organizers from the Tekken World Tour.</p>
